Definition: from G575 and the base of G3551; to apportion, i.e. bestow:--give.
BiblicalUsage: Once, to husbands. Dwell with your wives according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life — the word is the apportioning of honour, the deliberate bestowing of it where it is due.
TheologicalSignificance: Honour is not felt but given; Peter commands husbands to bestow it, and says their prayers depend on it.
